verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers ACH, wires, book transfers, FedNow, cards, and account statements extensively, but contains no mention of programmatic check issuance, remote deposit capture, or check image handling anywhere in the docs. The only check-related mention is a paper check issued upon account closure, which is not check issuance/deposit functionality. Missing for 10: any documentation of check issuance API, check deposit endpoint, image capture/upload for deposits, or check status tracking.
